text: dsh-cite-lens 是面向 DSH 网页端的 PDF 阅读插件，可在 Files 标签中显示可选中文本的 PDF 视图。选择论文段落后，可将带文件名和页码的引文及提问、解释或核查提示加入当前聊天草稿；聊天回复中的 PDF 页码和原文引用可变为链接，打开对应 PDF 并定位、突出显示文字。插件还提供每个聊天独立的 /cite-links 开关，提示模型为论文相关说法添加引用。适合在 DSH 中阅读论文、核对回答或检查修改后的文稿。需使用 DSH web profile 和现代浏览器；不要求 API 密钥。

dsh-cite-lens adds selectable PDFs to DSH web. Add cited passages to chat, then click reply citations to reopen the PDF and highlight matching text. The per-chat /cite-links option prompts the model to cite paper claims. Requires DSH web and a modern browser; no API key is required.

让聊天里的 PDF 原文引用可以点击后跳回对应页面并高亮文字。
Can I make every paper-related answer in a chat include links to the cited PDF passages?
dsh-cite-lens 的功能「引用 PDF 段落到聊天」：在 PDF 文本层选择一段文字后，可附带文件名和页码，以及提问或解释提示，加入当前聊天草稿。
dsh-cite-lens 的功能「从聊天定位 PDF 引文」：点击聊天回复中的页码或引文链接，可打开或切换到对应 PDF，查找引文文字并滚动、高亮显示所在位置。
dsh-cite-lens README · Introduction：

dsh-cite-lens README · dsh-cite-lens：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin for working on papers with the model, in the PDF you already have open.

dsh-cite-lens README · dsh-cite-lens：- **Select text in a PDF and ask about it.** PDFs in the **Files** tab open with selectable text. Select a passage and send it to the chat you are in — quoted, tagged with the file and page.
- **Click the model's citations.** When the model cites `[main.pdf p.7 "exact words"]`, the citation is a link: clicking it opens the PDF, scrolls to those words, and highlights them with a fading marker.
- **`/cite-links`** makes a chat back *every* claim about the paper with such a link — handy for reviewing a draft, or checking what the model changed after editing your LaTeX.

dsh-cite-lens README · dsh-cite-lens：**Everything stays on your machine.** The PDF is rendered in your browser with [PDF.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/); nothing is uploaded, and the plugin itself never sends a message — it only fills in your message box.

dsh-cite-lens README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cite-lens
```

Restart `dsh web`. PDFs you open from the **Files** tab now use Cite Lens. To go back to dsh's built-in PDF view, remove the plugin.

dsh-cite-lens README · Select a passage, ask about it：Select text and a toolbar appears over it:

| Button | Puts in your message box |
| --- | --- |
| **Quote** | the passage, tagged `main.pdf · p.17`, for you to write under |
| **Ask** | the passage, with the cursor waiting after `Question:` |
| **Explain** | the passage and a request to explain it |
| **Check this** | the passage and a request to check its claims against the paper |

Each is added *under* whatever you have already typed, in the chat you are in. Nothing is sent until you send it.

dsh-cite-lens README · Citations that open the PDF：The plugin adds a short note to each chat's system prompt describing the citation format, so the model can point at places like this:

| The model writes | Clicking it |
| --- | --- |
| `[p.7]` | the PDF you are reading, page 7 |
| `[main.pdf p.7]` | opens `main.pdf` (or switches to it) at page 7 |
| `[main.pdf "exact words"]` | opens it, finds the words anywhere in the PDF, highlights them |
| `[main.pdf p.7 "exact words"]` | the same, searching page 7 first |

dsh-cite-lens README · Citations that open the PDF：The page is optional on purpose: after the model edits your LaTeX it rarely knows which page a sentence lands on, so it quotes the words and Cite Lens finds them. Matching is forgiving — line breaks, words hyphenated across lines, ligatures, curly quotes and case are all ignored — and works on pages that have not been drawn yet. If the words are not in the PDF (it has not been rebuilt since the edit, say), the link tells you so instead of jumping somewhere wrong.

dsh-cite-lens README · Citations that open the PDF：Paths are relative to the chat's workspace (`[build/main.pdf "…"]`). A PDF that is not open is opened through dsh's Files tab. A bare `[p.7]` with nothing open reopens the PDF you used last.

dsh-cite-lens README · `/cite-links`：```
/cite-links          toggle for this chat
/cite-links on|off   set it
/cite-links status   ask
```

While it is on, every message you send goes in with a short reminder asking the model to back each statement about the paper with a link — in prose, lists and tables alike. A link icon in the chat's top bar shows the state (with a dot when on) and toggles it with a click. The setting is per chat and survives a restart.

dsh-cite-lens README · Requirements：- dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` or newer, **web** profile (`dsh web`). Developed against the 0.1.5 line and checked on `0.2.1-rc.3`: the PDF preview registers as an external-band renderer with `binaryExtensions: ['pdf']`, which is the contract both lines share.
- Node.js 22 or newer
- A current browser. Citation links are underlined with the CSS Custom Highlight API; in a browser without it they still work when clicked, they just are not underlined. Tested in Chrome.

dsh-cite-lens README · How it works：| Piece | dsh seam |
| --- | --- |
| The PDF view | `ctx.documentPreviews.register({ extensions: ['pdf'], priority: 'extension' })` and the keyed `sidebar.right.tab.document` slot — the external band ranks above the built-in view |
| Writing to your message box | the current chat (`ctx.sessions.list`) → its scope (`ctx.sessions.scope`) → `ctx.conversation.input.for(scope)`: the draft is read and appended to, never replaced, and never touched while a message is sending |
| Opening a cited PDF | `ctx.sidebarRight.openResource(address)` |
| Citation links | text ranges painted with `::highlight()` and hit-tested on click — the chat's DOM is never edited, so streaming replies are unaffected |
| The citation guide | a section in each chat's system prompt (`agent/session-start`) |
| `/cite-links` | a dsh command; while on, a reminder joins the step that carries your new prompt (`agent/pre-step`), once per prompt |

dsh-cite-lens README · How it works：Rendering stays smooth on long papers: pages are drawn one at a time nearest to where you are reading, first at 1× and then sharp once scrolling stops; far pages are freed; the text layer is built in idle time.

dsh-cite-lens README · Development：```sh
npm install      # PDF.js and esbuild (dev only — there are no runtime dependencies)
npm run build    # src/client → lib/client.js
npm test         # quoting, chat insertion, citation parsing, /cite-links, PDF.js text
```

`lib/client.js` is generated: edit `src/client/` and rebuild. It bundles PDF.js (Apache-2.0) and its worker, so the plugin needs no static file routes.
